entities.summary: Yulia Mykolaivna Mykytenko is a military servicewoman of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, combatant of the Russo-Ukrainian War, recipient of the Order of Bohdan Khmelnytsky and the Order for Courage, activist of the сivic movement "Vidsich" and of the NGO "Female veterans movement".
